overview:
# SoudeepGhoshal/GradAttn
**Stars**: 0 | **Language**: Jupyter Notebook
**Description**: The GradAttn repository contains experimental code for a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture named GradAttn. This architecture aims to improve image classification and representation learning by replacing fixed residual connections with attention-controlled gradient pathways. A transformer encoder processes multi-scale CNN features to dynamically route gradients across network layers. The repository includes self-contained Jupyter notebooks for various datasets (Tiny ImageNet, CIFAR-10, SVHN, FashionMNIST, TissueMNIST, BloodMNIST, PCam, PAD-UFES-20), each demonstrating baseline ResNet-18 models alongside GradAttn variants (No PE, Learnable PE, RoPE) and attention-augmented comparisons (SENet, CBAM) where applicable. Training configurations are standardized across models, utilizing the Adam optimizer, a learning rate of 1e-3, and specific LR scheduling and early stopping criteria. A `GradientFlowAnalyzer` class is included in each notebook to instrument PyTorch models, collect gradient statistics, and assess gradient health. The transformer encoder configuration is consistent across all GradAttn variants, featuring an embedding dimension of 256, feedforward dimension of 512, 8 attention heads, 3 encoder layers, and 0.1 dropout.
